caption: The drawing depicts a set of garments, primarily consisting of a pink, knee-length chemise with matching pantalettes. The chemise features wide, squared sleeves, gathered fabric across the shoulders, and an open neckline with yellow shoulder straps. There is a vertical beige placket with a small pink button or clasp at the center front. Decorative details include a band of stitched or gathered fabric running horizontally below the neckline and another band above the waist, with short lines suggesting embroidery or stitching hanging from it. Below the chemise, pink pantalettes extend to the calves and are adorned with a zigzag or sawtooth lace trim at the hems. To the right side of the main illustration, there are two technical sketches in pencil: the upper one shows the pantalettes from the front, including the waistband, seams, and open crotch area, while the lower one presents the pantalettes from the back, detailing the waistband, seams, and construction lines. The overall composition presents the colored garment centrally and the two construction sketches aligned vertically on the right-hand side, all set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Boy's Suit
